name: Sturgeon-head hotpot
summary: Sturgeon farmed in Măng Đen’s cold water, the head simmered in a hotpot with sour bamboo shoots, tomato, lemongrass, and chili. The broth is clean and sweet, with no fishy taste.
origin: A Măng Đen hotpot from the cold-water sturgeon farms on the plateau.
taste: Clean and sweet, and not fishy.
howToEat: Share the pot of sturgeon head with sour bamboo, tomato, lemongrass, and chili.
seoDescription: Farmed sturgeon head in a hotpot with sour bamboo, tomato, lemongrass, and chili, in Măng Đen.
